lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 7 distinct vertical white lines visible. Spacing is non-uniform, with the widest gap occurring between the posterior-most line and the second line, narrowing as they approach the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 4th line from the posterior, showing a Y-shaped topological split approximately 20% down from the dorsal crest.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st and 7th lines are significantly abbreviated, occupying only the upper third of the torso height. Lines 2 and 6 terminate abruptly before reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct high-contrast white spots are located on the posterior flank/lower haunch, arranged in a low-density triangular formation.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two inferior spots on the haunch exhibit a horizontal linear alignment parallel to the ventral plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate spiral geometry. The horns transition from a posterior-lateral sweep at the base to an inward medial curve, terminating in an upward vertical trajectory.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.75 times the combined pixel width of the two horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 10-15% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal mane extending from the nape to the tail base; distinct white 'chevron' marking across the bridge of the muzzle; white patch visible on the interior carpal joint of the right forelimb.
